decision: All 18 are review candidates, none accepted for training. Original 12/18 geometry remains unresolved. No held-out family used.
limitations: One training phone family and three fixed pickup slots, no randomized bin.
Fixed hand orientation; four actions encode XYZ target delta and gripper only.
Active robot self-contacts sampled at physics steps; contact forces remain unvalidated.
Camera projection bounds do not rule out occlusion.
